landmarks.name: Chapel of St. Anna
landmarks.text: Built in 1743 by the first families of the valley.

landmarks.name: Lago Bianco
landmarks.text: The village lake, frozen solid from November to April.

landmarks.name: Almhütte
landmarks.text: The mid station hut: soup, strudel and the best view of the valley.

landmarks.name: The Kessel
landmarks.text: A natural amphitheatre where three valleys meet.

landmarks.name: Eisfeld Station
landmarks.text: The highest chairlift in the valley, at the foot of the Kronhorn.

landmarks.name: Gipfelkreuz
landmarks.text: The summit cross at 2432 m: the roof of the ski area.

landmarks.name: Adler's Eyrie
landmarks.text: Eagles nest on the cliffs below this ridge shoulder.

landmarks.name: Wolf's Den
landmarks.text: An old woodcutters' cabin, roof caved in under the snow.

landmarks.name: Sonnenalp Park
landmarks.text: Six kickers of growing size beside the piste.

landmarks.name: Nebel Bowl
landmarks.text: A hidden bowl of untouched powder above the mist.
